verdict.rationale: Unity documents its own Asset Database import pipeline, which converts and syncs source assets automatically. It also documents command-line/batchmode launch for automating workflows and public scripting APIs for customization, so pipeline-style automation of incoming assets is plausibly supported, but only glancingly. missing for 10: documented import hooks (e.g., import postprocessing callbacks), import presets, custom importer scripting, worked pipeline-script examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
